title: AI Architect
description:
AI Architect
Up to £105,000

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing technology consultancy at the forefront of AI, Data and Cloud transformation, helping enterprise clients solve complex business challenges through innovative AI-driven solutions. You will play a key role in defining AI strategy, designing enterprise architectures and leading the delivery of production-grade Agentic AI and Generative AI platforms.

As part of a highly collaborative consulting team, you will work with senior stakeholders to shape AI roadmaps, establish governance frameworks and deliver scalable AI solutions that provide measurable business value. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies helping organisations move from experimentation to enterprise-wide AI adoption.

This position would suit someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership skills and a proven track record of architecting and delivering production-ready AI solutions within complex enterprise environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design and delivery of Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions for enterprise clients.
  • Define and implement multi-agent architectures, orchestration frameworks and AI platform standards.
  • Design scalable RAG solutions, vector search capabilities and knowledge management architectures.
  • Establish AI governance, Responsible AI and security frameworks to support enterprise adoption.
  • Create reusable AI accelerators, frameworks and delivery standards across client engagements.
  • Lead AI strategy workshops, architecture reviews and technical discovery sessions with senior stakeholders.
  • Define MLOps and LLMOps best practices for deployment, monitoring, evaluation and lifecycle management.

Skills & Experience

  • Extensive experience designing and delivering AI, machine learning and data-driven solutions within enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures and AI agent frameworks.
  • Proven track record delivering production-grade AI platforms rather than proof-of-concept solutions.
  • Strong Python skills alongside experience designing distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience implementing MLOps and LLMOps frameworks, including monitoring, evaluation and model governance.
  • Knowledge of Azure, AWS or GCP, alongside CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong understanding of AI governance, security, compliance and Responsible AI principles.

What's On Offer?

  • Salary up to £105,000.
  • Remote working.
  • Opportunity to lead cutting-edge AI, Agentic AI and Generative AI transformation programmes.
  • Ongoing professional development, training and certifications.
  • Clear progression opportunities within a growing consultancy.
  • Private healthcare and life assurance.
  • Supportive, collaborative and highly technical team environment.
  • Opportunity to shape AI architecture standards, frameworks and best practices.
